objects.name: totals
variables: It shows one row for each region with a total.
It sums the amount of only the orders that have the paid status.
It groups the rows by the region.

objects.name: rows
variables: It counts all rows of the orders feed, with no filter.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
The object `totals` works and shows no error.
notes: Feed ends at 600 rows. When rows is 600, report totals for each region. Column names can change; repair the filter and aggregate with the new names.
